proposed_model.pk_structure: One-compartment linear model with first-order elimination
proposed_model.equation: dA/dt = -CL/V * A; C(t) = Dose/V * exp(-CL/V * t)
proposed_model.random_effects: Log-normal IIV on CL and V
proposed_model.rationale: Rapid turnaround, adequate for single-dose IV bolus; escalate to two-compartment only if one-compartment fails convergence or shows systematic bias in terminal phase

covariates_to_test.rationale: Standard immunotherapy clearance driver; test continuous form first

covariates_to_test.covariate: Genotype (if available; e.g., CYP3A4, transporter variants)
covariates_to_test.rationale: Expected metabolic heterogeneity; binary or multi-level indicator
Standard physiological scaling; test if IIV on V remains high after renal/genotype adjustment

covariates_to_test.model: Linear or exponential; test after renal function (may be redundant)
covariates_to_test.rationale: Screen for independent age effect after controlling for eGFR

covariates_to_test.model: Retain as stratification factor for sensitivity analysis only
covariates_to_test.rationale: Per instructions: treat as operational unless raw data values are implausible (e.g., negative concentrations, impossible times)

validation_checks.method: Evaluate minimization message, condition number, standard errors <30% for primary parameters
validation_checks.threshold: OFV decrease >3.84 (χ² 1 df) vs. null; all parameters estimated with <50% RSE
validation_checks.action_if_fail: Escalate to two-compartment model or investigate data quality

validation_checks.method: Observed vs. population predictions (OFVpop); observed vs. individual predictions (OFVind); residuals vs. time and concentration
validation_checks.threshold: No systematic bias in residual plots; mean OFVpop and OFVind near zero; RMSE <20% of observed range
validation_checks.action_if_fail: Revise residual error model (add exponential component); check for outliers

validation_checks.method: Likelihood ratio test (LRT): ΔOFV ≥ 3.84 for single covariate (p≈0.05); ΔOFV ≥ 2.71 for removal (p≈0.10, forward-backward)
validation_checks.threshold: Retain covariates with ΔOFV ≥ 3.84; apply automated forward/backward elimination
validation_checks.action_if_fail: Exclude non-significant covariate; document in sensitivity analysis

validation_checks.method: Cook's distance, DFBETAS, or weighted residuals |>2.5 SD|
validation_checks.threshold: Flag observations with |weighted residuals| >3.0 for review
validation_checks.action_if_fail: Investigate source; retain in primary but report sensitivity analysis with exclusion

validation_checks.method: 1000 bootstrap replicates for parameter confidence intervals; VPC with 1000 simulations stratified by dose/weight/eGFR if covariates present
validation_checks.threshold: Bootstrap 95% CI includes population estimate; observed percentiles (5th, 50th, 95th) within simulated prediction bands
validation_checks.action_if_fail: Investigate model misspecification or sparse data within strata; consider pooling categories

validation_checks.method: Plot individual Cmax/AUC vs. efficacy (e.g., biomarker change, response rate) and safety (adverse event incidence)
validation_checks.threshold: Visual separation of exposure quartiles; sigmoidal or logistic dose-response model ΔOFV >3.84 vs. null
validation_checks.action_if_fail: Report exposure ranges with observed outcomes; acknowledge limited ER resolution if sparse

efficacy_exposure.method: Fit sigmoidal Emax model to efficacy biomarker or response vs. individual exposure; estimate EC50 and EC90
efficacy_exposure.threshold_action: Define 'adequate efficacy' as exposure ≥EC50; 'maximal efficacy' as ≥EC90; recommend dosing to achieve median population AUC/Cmax in efficacy range

safety_exposure.metric: Adverse event rate by exposure quartile
safety_exposure.method: Logistic regression: AE incidence vs. exposure (Cmax/AUC); estimate exposure threshold for clinically acceptable toxicity (<Grade 2 or <20% incidence)
safety_exposure.threshold_action: Define upper exposure boundary as concentration at which AE risk exceeds target (e.g., >30% Grade ≥2); cap individual CL adjustments to stay below this limit

subgroup_dosing_rules.method: Stratify population by significant covariates (e.g., eGFR categories, genotype); calculate median CL and required dose adjustment multiplier relative to standard population
subgroup_dosing_rules.example: eGFR >90: no adjustment; eGFR 60–89: 0.85× standard dose; eGFR 30–59: 0.70× standard dose; eGFR <30: specialist review
subgroup_dosing_rules.threshold_action: Recommend dose reduction if predicted exposure (AUC/Cmax) falls below efficacy threshold or exceeds safety threshold for subgroup

model_selection.criterion: Use one-compartment if OFVone-comp is <2.71 units higher than two-compartment; otherwise adopt two-compartment
model_selection.justification: Rapid turnaround prioritized; parsimonious model acceptable for dosing guidance unless terminal phase data strongly favor complexity

planned_report_outputs.output: Population PK parameter estimates with uncertainty
planned_report_outputs.format: Table: CL (L/h), V (L), IIV (%), RSE (%); Bootstrap 95% CI
Table: Covariate, parameter, effect size, ΔOFV, p-value, interpretation (e.g., 'Each 10 mL/min increase in eGFRCL increases by 5%')
Plots and table: Efficacy biomarker and safety incidence vs. AUC/Cmax quartiles; EC50, Emax, toxicity threshold with 95% CI
Table and nomogram: Recommended dose (or dose multiplier) by eGFR category, genotype, and bodyweight; corresponding predicted median and 10th–90th percentile AUC/Cmax for each subgroup
planned_report_outputs.audience: Clinical and regulatory teams; investigator briefing

planned_report_outputs.format: Four-panel plot (OFVpop vs. population prediction, OFVind vs. individual prediction, weighted residuals vs. time, weighted residuals vs. prediction); VPC plot stratified by primary covariate
Brief text: Convergence status, bootstrap summary (median and 95% CI for each parameter), VPC interpretation, outlier flagging and sensitivity analysis results
One-way tables: Effect on parameter estimates and dosing recommendations of excluding suspected outliers, dropping non-significant covariates, and switching to two-compartment model (if applicable)
